title: The Gating Mechanism of KV Cache Eviction
abstract: arXiv:2611.07605v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: KV cache eviction must decide which entries carry information that the rest of the cache can no longer supply. A natural way to estimate this is a learnable gate: give each cached entry a gate on its attention weight and train the gate on the model's own objective. The gate belongs inside the normalizing softmax, where suppressing one entry hands its mass to the others rather than discarding it. That same normalizer absorbs any per-query constant, so a constant gate cancels and reproduces the frozen model exactly. Trained on the language-modeling loss the gate stays near a constant score while its loss falls throughout: optimization succeeds, but a frozen backbone was fit for dense attention, so its loss prefers the no-op, and a near-constant score ranks nothing. The no-op is not a floor the gate improves from but what its objective asks for. A second obstacle survives once the gate moves, since the same gradient charges the gate for err

translated_abstract: KV缓存的驱逐必须判断哪些条目承载着缓存中其余部分无法再提供的信息。估计这一点的一种自然方法是引入可学习的门控：为每个缓存条目的注意力权重设置一个门控，并用模型自身的目标函数来训练该门控。门控应当位于归一化softmax的内部，在这里抑制某个条目意味着将其概率质量转交给其他条目，而非将其直接丢弃。同一个归一化因子会吸收任何逐查询的常数，因此常数门控会被抵消，从而精确复现冻结的模型。在语言建模损失上训练时，门控始终保持接近常数分数，而其损失却全程下降：优化本身是成功的，但由于冻结的骨干网络是为密集注意力拟合的，其损失天然偏好无操作解，而接近常数的分数无法对任何条目进行排序。无操作并非门控可以借此改进的下限，而恰恰是其目标函数所要求的结果。当门控开始移动后，第二个障碍仍然存在，因为相同的梯度会让门控为错误承担代价（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文揭示了KV缓存驱逐中可学习门控的内在困境：位于softmax内部的门控会因归一化吸收常数而使常数门控退化为无操作，且为密集注意力拟合的冻结骨干网络的语言建模损失本身就偏好无操作解，导致门控虽优化成功却无法学习出有意义的驱逐排序。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the inherent dilemma of learnable gates for KV cache eviction: a gate inside the softmax sees constant values canceled by the normalizer, and the language-modeling loss of a dense-attention-fitted frozen backbone itself prefers the no-op solution, so optimization succeeds while the gate learns no meaningful eviction ranking.
